title: Not syncing with Apple Watch
body:
I absolutely love this app, but it has so many issues with real-time sync with an Apple Watch. 

If I started something on the phone app it often times doesn't sync with the watch. If I start from the watch, it almost never records that on the phone. The best way is to start from the phone and leave it open, which kind of defeats the purpose of improving habits and keeps you going without worrying about the phone.
author: Luannee
